author: PieZ
body:
Getting objective is supposed to be hard to get. Not to mention that it is very easy to get to the enemy side, it is easy to to blocks up 15 or so blocks and mine the monument for 2 seconds. As a defender is makes it almost impossible to defend unless you know how to stop the 2-3 player horde that comes at the monument and usually all by yourself or you get lucky.

It just makes gameplay terrible
